column3: Pipe, fitting, flanges and spacers supplied by Acid Piping Technologies, MONDITM alloy.
Ductile iron spacers will be used between flanges for field trim of pre-spooled pipe.

All flange faces will be machined flush with the end of the pipe spool or fitting, c/w special phonograph serrated finish.  Machined grooves will have a sharp profile and a depth of 0.008in (approx.).
After machining, the flange faces must be perpendicular to the pipe or fitting centerline.
All threads and thread tapers will conform to ASME B1.20.1.
